## Workload

During the review period, Priya Anand completed 764 reads over 360 hours, averaging 2.1 reads per hour. This workload reflects the volume of cases assessed and the time allocated to completing the reviews. The activity was recorded for the grading review and provides the basis for considering both output and quality.

## Quality

A sample of 68 reads was checked. Agreement was 82.4 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent interpretation and help clarify the expected grading approach. The checked cases and agreement result should be considered alongside the overall workload when reviewing performance.

The grader was Priya Anand, and the review was also completed by Priya Anand.
